messages:
amy_chen: Heads-up — VantageCloud wants a short POC focused on throughput vs tail latency before we push pricing. They want sustained 250 qps for chat completion with 99.9th-pct < 600ms and ability to absorb 1k qps microbursts for 30s. Also flagged KMS + SOC2 questions. Can eng help with a concise load plan? :eyes:

max_pat: I can run the load plan. Quick Q: is the workload single-turn prompt generation or multi-turn chat (KV cache heavy)?

amy_chen: Multi-turn, average 4 turns, 600 tokens input avg, 80 tokens output. They use OpenAI chat-like API semantics.

jules_sre: For my sanity: are we testing Hosted API or Dedicated? Bursts change sizing.

amy_chen: Starting hosted — they may upgrade to Dedicated if cost/latency needs it. Need numbers for both ideally.

ravi_soleng: Proposed approach: two benches — 1) Sustained 250 qps for 15m to capture steady-state. 2) Microburst profile: hold 1k qps for 30s then back to 250 qps for 5m to observe tail. We'll capture p50/p95/p99/p999 and GPU utilization. Also do variant with KV cache enabled to show tail improvements.

max_pat: Sounds good. I'll use our internal harness + k6 for traffic shaping. Example command for microburst shape: ```k6 run --vus 1000 --duration 30s script_burst.js``` and for sustained steady-state: ```k6 run --vus 250 --duration 15m script_steady.js``` will parameterize token lengths.

jules_sre: Add ramp times — don't want sudden connection storms to hit infra limits. Proposed: 10s ramp to peak for burst. Also set `keep-alive` and reuse connections. We'll capture TCP connection churn metrics.

olivia_sec: From security side: VantageCloud requests confirmation that Hosted endpoints support CMKs and envelope encryption, plus audit logs retention for 12 months. We should attach the SOC2 summary and KMS integration doc.

ravi_soleng: We can confirm CMK support and provide the KMS integration note. For audit logs, Console has configurable retention; I'll note the default + enterprise options.

amy_chen: Pricing ask: they want an estimate if they hit sustained 250 qps for 24h vs Dedicated reservation. Can finance/product give a ballpark for tokens -> cost at current catalog?

max_pat: For bench we can extrapolate token burn from sample traces. I'll capture avg tokens per response and compute cost at hosted rates. For Dedicated, we need throughput per GPU metric — I'll include estimated GPU-hours and perf per-card.

jules_sre: Action items for me: prepare a runbook with traffic shapes, ramp profiles, and metrics to collect (p50/p95/p99/p999, tail CPU/GPU spool, queue lengths, error rates, timeouts). I'll also add the fallback test: simulate model fallback to smaller variant during burst.

ravi_soleng: I'll prep the harness and sample payloads, plus the k6 scripts. Will include a small `wrk` snippet for low-level perf sanity: ```wrk -t12 -c400 -d30s --latency http://api.redwood/v1/complete```

amy_chen: Timing: VantageCloud wants results by EOD Fri (4 days). Is that feasible?

max_pat: EOD Fri is tight but doable if we keep scope narrow. We should prioritize Hosted baseline with KV cache on/off, one burst profile, and cost extrapolation. Dedicated estimates can be back-of-envelope.

olivia_sec: I'll draft the KMS/SOC2 blurb and attach link to the compliance pack. Any PII handling specifics from the customer?

amy_chen: They said no PHI in the test; using synthetic payloads. Good to go.

jules_sre: I'll schedule a short smoke run tomorrow morning to validate scripts and avoid wasted runs during business hours. Who wants access to the raw perf logs?

ravi_soleng: Send logs to me + max and attach to the sales POC doc. I'll generate the p99/p999 plots.

deploy-bot: New job scheduled: `poc/vantagecloud/smoke-2026-03-25` — status: scheduled by jules_sre.

amy_chen: Perfect. Thanks all — I'll update VantageCloud slack thread with this plan and keep them cc'd. :tada:
